description: This file defines the BestImagePlugin class, which is a plugin for selecting the best available recipe image based on various criteria such as dimensions and URL properties. It includes methods for collecting image candidates from different sources, normalizing entries, parsing dimensions, and scoring candidates.

classes.name: BestImagePlugin
classes.description: A plugin class for selecting the best recipe image based on size and URL properties.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Decorator method to wrap functions for selecting the best image.

methods.name: _collect_candidates
methods.description: Collects image candidates from primary image, schema, and OpenGraph data.

methods.name: _normalize_entries
methods.description: Normalizes different formats of image entries into a standard dictionary with url, width, and height.

methods.name: _collect_opengraph_candidates
methods.description: Extracts image candidates from OpenGraph meta tags in HTML soup.

methods.name: _merge_candidate
methods.description: Merges a candidate image into the candidates list, updating dimensions and sources.

methods.name: _max_dimension
methods.description: Returns the maximum of two dimension values.

methods.name: _parse_dimension
methods.description: Parses dimension values from strings, dicts, or numeric types.

methods.name: _select_best_candidate
methods.description: Selects the best candidate based on size, security, and order.

methods.name: _score_candidate
methods.description: Scores a candidate image based on area, security, and order.

methods.name: _ensure_dimensions
methods.description: Ensures width and height are set, extracting from URL if necessary.

methods.name: _extract_dimensions_from_url
methods.description: Extracts width and height from image URL using regex patterns.

methods.name: _find_query_dimension
methods.description: Finds dimension parameters in URL query strings.
